newsitem.title: FINLAND: FORECAST - Stockmann 1996 profit seen up.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Stockmann 1996 profit seen up.

text.p: A Reuters survey of analysts covering Finnish equities showed a 295 million markka median forecast for Finnish retail group Oy Stockmann Ab's full-year profit before extraordinary items and tax:
(Profit forecasts by 13 analysts, EPS by 11 analysts)
Stockmann's results are due on February 13, tentatively around midday.
In 1995, Stockmann had a 280 million markka profit before extraordinary items and tax.
For the company's full-year 1997 profit, eight of the 13 analysts polled gave a median forecast of 340 million markka (mean 340 million) in a 315-360 million markka range.

Contributors to the survey were Alfred Berg, Aktia Bank, Aros Securities, Carnegie Securities, Enskilda Securities, Erik Selin, FIM Securities, Handelsbanken, Interbank, Kleinwort Benson, Merita Securities, Opstock and Postipankki.
